messages:
maria-infra: Quick handoff — planning a large replay + soak tonight (start window 00:30-01:00 UTC). Goal: reproduce a 2x traffic spike and run 2h soak at peak.
sam-runtime: Ack. Are we doing k6 or Locust for the replay driver?
jess-eng: Also need the checklist: canary, smoke gates, perf hooks, who owns abort.
maria-infra: We'll use k6 for traffic shapes + a small Locust job for session-level behaviours. Canaries will be a 10min k6 run at 5% traffic first.
noah-sre: Add me to the abort list. Smoke gates: svc health + p95 latency < 300ms + error rate < 0.5% during canary. If any fail, auto-abort.
kevin-ml: ML side: we'll pin model to v2.3-quant for the main run. If we see quality regressions, fallback to v2.1-fp16. Need to record a sample of outputs for eval.
sam-runtime: Perf hooks: please enable kernel tracing and nvmetrics. I'll attach nsys command. Also enable runtime token-level telemetry for 30s windows.
replay-bot: Scheduled: k6-replay-nightly at 2026-03-18T00:45:00Z. Logs -> https://redwood.internal/logs/k6/1876543210
maria-infra: k6 ramp plan: 0->50% over 10m, to 100% in 20m, hold 120m, then decay 10m.
jess-eng: For profiling: can we collect flamegraphs on one replica? If so, where to push them.
sam-runtime: yes. Run on replica rt-prof-1. Command (example):\n```\nnsys profile -o /tmp/rt_prof --trace=cuda,kern,cudaMemory -t none --sample=cpu python3 -m runtime.server\n```\nUpload to s3://redwood-perf/replays/1876543210/
noah-sre: Alerting: I'll set a temporary pager if p99>1s for 5m. Also disk iops guardrails — target under 10k IOPS per node.
kevin-ml: I'll collect 500 random prompts and the model outputs for regression diff. Team: please don't run imports that change token distribution during run window.
maria-infra: KV cache: enable prefix cache for warm paths. Disable background cache warm on canary. If cache-hit drops >15%, abort.
sam-runtime: Also note: batch size tweak applied to model-serving config: batch_limit=2048 -> 1024 for run. Rollback on abort is automatic.
jess-eng: Who will kick the run at 00:45? I can if everyone is ready.
maria-infra: Thanks Jess. Please kick and post short readiness: infra ok / canary ok / perf hooks attached.
replay-bot: Canary complete (5%): green. k6 full ramp starting now. link: https://redwood.internal/replay/1876543210/progress
noah-sre: Observability check: GPU util steady ~78%, mem ok, no OOMs. p95 trending up to 260ms.
kevin-ml: Sampling artifacts uploaded: s3://redwood-perf/replays/1876543210/samples.tar.gz
sam-runtime: Started nsys collect on rt-prof-1. PID 4242. I'll stop at 30m mark or on abort.
maria-infra: Mid-run note: slight increase in KV eviction — monitoring. If eviction rate > 12% for 10m, we'll reduce concurrency.
jess-eng: Thx all. If anything funky, @noah-sre or @sam-runtime, ping and I'll hit abort. Otherwise I'll collect post-run summaries and open a perf ticket.
replay-bot: Run complete: soak 120m finished. Summary: errors 0.28%, p50 45ms, p95 265ms, p99 780ms. Artifacts: https://redwood.internal/artifacts/1876543210
maria-infra: Nice. Followups: (1) analyze flamegraph (sam) (2) KV tuning (infra) (3) model quality diffs (kevin). I'll file the action items.
sam-runtime: I'll upload perf diffs and kernel breakdown by EOD.
kevin-ml: I'll run evals on sampled outputs and post regression report.
noah-sre: Closing the temporary pager. Thanks team :thumbsup:
